estimates.assumptions: 450ml vegetable oil ≈ 405g (density ~0.9 g/ml); all oil is incorporated into the batter
400g plain white flour; standard nutritional values for wheat flour
2 tsp bicarbonate of soda ≈ 10g; negligible calories, protein and fat
550ml granulated sugar ≈ 440g (bulk density ~0.8 g/ml); all sugar is white table sugar
5 large eggs ≈ 300g total edible portion (60g each without shell); average values for whole raw eggs
½ tsp salt ≈ 3g; negligible calories, protein and fat
2 tsp ground cinnamon ≈ 5g; negligible calories, protein and fat
500g grated carrots; raw, peeled, edible portion only
150g chopped walnuts; standard values for shelled nuts
200g full-fat cream cheese; standard nutritional values
150g caster sugar; same as granulated white sugar
100g unsalted butter; all used in the icing
